d:
Set against the backdrop of the imposing pyramids, this haunting love song picturised on King Khan, Shah Rukh and the gorgeious Kajol, has the melodious voices of Sonu Nigam and Alka Yagnik to further enhance the beauty.
Song Name - Suraj Hua Maddham
Movie - Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham
Singer - Sonu Nigam & Alka Yagnik
Lyrics - Anil Pandey
Music - Sandesh Shandilya
Director - Karan Johar
Studio - Dharma Productions
